payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1037 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
